valuation.method: Forward adjusted EPS x justified P/E, with FY2027 EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027). FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $5.04-$5.06 (midpoint $5.05, 7.0%-7.5% growth) in the Q3 2026 release of 26 Oct 2026. FY2027 base EPS of $5.30 sits near the third-party consensus of about $5.25-$5.31 (Yahoo Finance 23-analyst average $5.31; not a company figure). Listing is the USD NYSE share, so no FX conversion is needed. Bear, base and bull EPS and multiples are model assumptions, not company guidance.

bear.driver: Wireless price competition and promotional intensity erode postpaid phone growth and ARPU, and the SpaceX spectrum deal raises disruption risk to the fixed-wireless and mobile franchise; the multiple de-rates toward the low end of the telecom range

base.driver: Management delivers the raised 2026 guide and modest 2027 growth from postpaid phone net adds, broadband and fiber expansion, and cost cuts; EBITDA and free cash flow growth support the dividend and buybacks

bull.driver: Lower churn and stronger account additions, plus cost savings and convergence bundling, lift EPS; the market re-rates the stock as a cash-flow compounder at the top of the telecom multiple range

valuation.implied_by_close: At the 2026 guidance midpoint of $5.05 the close of $46.36 implies 9.2x; at the base FY2027 EPS of $5.30 it implies 8.7x. The base 9.5x multiple puts the target 8.6% above the close, while the Bullstory 22-analyst mean of $50.65 implies about 9.6x FY2027 EPS of $5.30.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $5.30 (about 11.4 pp of the close). A $0.10 change in FY2027 EPS at 9.5x moves the base target by $0.95 (about 2.0 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Postpaid phone net additions and postpaid phone ARPU/churn, together with FY2027 adjusted EPS guidance. Guidance for 2027 adjusted EPS below about $5.10 or a fall in postpaid phone net adds below the 1.1-1.2 million 2026 guide would weaken the base case.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results and FY2027 outlook, expected around late January 2027 (date not confirmed in the sources reviewed).

analyst_notes: Partial panel of brokerage views dated 29 Oct 2026, after the Q3 release. Targets were trimmed at Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, TD Cowen, Daiwa, Barclays and BNP Paribas Exane, with Citi's Michael Rollins (Buy, $55 to $53) the only named analyst found. Ratings split with three Buy-equivalents against one Equal-Weight. The source gives no 12-month horizon disclosure, so all events stay in the timeline and out of the weighted target. The Bullstory aggregate mean of $50.65 (22 analysts, Nov 2026) sits about $0.30 above the base target, while the median of the 11 firm-level targets in the 29 Oct table is $50, about $0.35 below base, a gap of roughly 0.1 turn of P/E. The sources do not show which EPS or multiple the brokers use.
